name: Canvas Launch
description: A launch page for a design tool, told as a scroll-through product film: lowercase captions ruled across warm paper, and under them the tool's own editor — drawn in code — opening, importing a live page, building a sample app's screens from outlines, working beside an agent and a code editor, then bring it, shape it, ship it. Light and dark, every colour a CSS variable.
designedFor: Launching a developer or design tool with a product film instead of a feature grid
Showing a product's real interface, drawn in code so it stays sharp at any zoom
Waitlist and early-access pages with one clear ask at the end
Studying a pinned, beat-by-beat scroll story built with Framer Motion and Lenis
